lines.japanese: 俺の小鳩を紹介しよう。
lines.english: Let me introduce my little lovebird.

lines.japanese: あ、いえ「俺の」っていうのは単なる言葉のアヤでね？
lines.english: Oh, no, the “my” there was just a figure of speech, okay?

lines.japanese: ほら、コバトとコイビトって、ちょっぴり似てるでしょ。だから語呂がいいかな、なんて思って口走っちゃっただけで。あの、べつになんか、深い意味とかはないんです。
lines.english: See, Kobato means “little dove,” and “lovebird” isn't much of a leap from there. It just had a nice ring to it, so it slipped out. That's all. There wasn't any, you know, deeper meaning behind it.

lines.japanese: そりゃあ言うまでもなく、この星の宝であるところの小鳩さんは誰の所有物でもないですし。ええ、ええ。
lines.english: It goes without saying that Kobato, treasure of this very planet, belongs to no one. Of course. Yes.

lines.japanese: あっ、ぼくのキャラ変ですか？　いつもと違いますか？　ですよね。なんか、たまにこうなっちゃうんですよ。小鳩さん絡みの話になりますとね、ええ、なんかたまに。
lines.english: What, I'm acting out of character? I don't sound like myself? Right, right. This just happens to me sometimes. Whenever the subject of Kobato comes up, yes, every now and then.

lines.japanese: あー、ごほんごほん。
lines.english: Ahem. Ahem.

lines.japanese: よし、気を取りなおして──
lines.english: All right, let's start over—

lines.japanese: ──俺の妹を紹介しよう。
lines.english: —Let me introduce my sister.

lines.japanese: この神が造りたもうた至高の芸術、ヒトという種の限界を超えてしまった美貌の持ち主が、羽田小鳩。通称ポッポちゃんだ。
lines.english: This crowning achievement of God's creation, this beauty who surpasses the limits of the human species, is Kobato Haneda. Also known as Poppo.

lines.japanese: 「どうしたの、お兄ちゃん。ぼけっとして」
lines.english: “What's wrong, Big Brother? You're spacing out.”

lines.japanese: 「ああいや、ちょっと芸術鑑賞を」
lines.english: “Oh, nothing. Just admiring a work of art.”

lines.japanese: 「またわけ分かんないこと言ってないで、早くごはん食べちゃいなよ」
lines.english: “Quit saying weird stuff and hurry up and eat.”

lines.japanese: 「はーい」
lines.english: “Okaaay.”

lines.japanese: 小鳩お手製の七草粥をハフハフいただく。今日は１月７日だった。
lines.english: I blew on each spoonful of Kobato's homemade seven-herb rice porridge and dug in. It was January 7.

lines.japanese: まあ、今でこそ穏やかな兄妹の距離を取りもどした俺たちだが、ちょっと前までは、おかしな空気にとり憑かれていた。
lines.english: Now, we've since regained the comfortable distance between brother and sister, but until recently, a strange atmosphere had us in its grip.

lines.japanese: 発端は小鳩の誕生日──世間で言うところのクリスマスイブ。
lines.english: It began on Kobato's birthday—what the rest of the world calls Christmas Eve.

lines.japanese: あの夜、俺たちは互いの想いを認めあった。
lines.english: That night, we acknowledged how we felt about each other.

lines.japanese: 家族としてではなく、それ以上の想いを抱いていると。
lines.english: That what we felt went beyond our bond as family.

lines.japanese: そして、あのひととき、気持ちはたしかに繋がった。
lines.english: And for that one moment, our hearts truly met.

lines.japanese: だが俺は兄として、なにより彼女の幸せと健やかな成長を願うひとりの男として、冷静たらんとした。
lines.english: But as her brother—and, above all, as a man who wished for her happiness and healthy growth—I resolved to remain calm.

lines.japanese: 俺たちは──とくに小鳩は──まだ未熟だ。
lines.english: We were still immature—Kobato especially.

lines.japanese: あまり一般的ではない環境に因われてきた俺たちは、これまで互いの存在しか拠り所を知らず、互いの存在を守ることにその短い生涯を捧げてきた。
lines.english: Trapped as we had been in unusual circumstances, we had never known anyone but each other to depend on, and had devoted our brief lives to protecting one another.

lines.japanese: その強さや弱さは、必然的に自我の大半を構成するものであり、果たしてそれは安易に恋と呼んでいいものだろうか。
lines.english: That strength and that weakness inevitably formed the greater part of who we were. Could we really call it love so easily?

lines.japanese: 俺たちはまだ未熟だ。
lines.english: We were still immature.

lines.japanese: 心は逸るが、結論を急ぐことはない。
lines.english: Our hearts might race ahead, but there was no need to rush to an answer.

lines.japanese: これから遅れを取りもどすように、この広大な世を渡り、数えきれぬほどのひとと出会い、こぼれるほどの見識を蓄えてゆくだろう。
lines.english: From then on, we would make up for lost time: travel this vast world, meet more people than we could count, and amass more knowledge than we could hold.

lines.japanese: そうしてあらゆるものを俯瞰できる客観的な視野を持ったとき──
lines.english: And once we had gained the perspective to look down upon all things objectively—

lines.japanese: ──俺たちが未熟ではなくなってなお、もしまだこの想いを変わらず恋と呼べたなら、そのときこそふたり真に向かいあおう。
lines.english: —if, even after we were no longer immature, we could still call these feelings love, then and only then would we truly face each other.

lines.japanese: 唇ではなく額にくちづけをして、そう誓った。
lines.english: I kissed her forehead rather than her lips, and made that vow.

lines.japanese: やがてそのときの訪れるまで、互いの想いに封をして家族であろうと。
lines.english: Until that day came, we would seal away our feelings and remain a family.

lines.japanese: そう、約束したんだ。
lines.english: That was our promise.
Pwaaah...

lines.japanese: おっと失礼。つい思いだして、温かな気持ちに浸ってしまったよ。
lines.english: Oh, pardon me. The memory swept me away into that warm and tender feeling.

lines.japanese: いや、しかし問題はここからだ。
lines.english: But the real problem began afterward.

lines.japanese: 結論を将来へ先送りしたとは言え、一度は男女として両想いであることを認めてしまったのである。しばらく俺たちはおかしな空気に冒された。
lines.english: We may have deferred our answer to the future, but once we'd admitted that our feelings were mutual and romantic, a strange atmosphere hung over us for a while.

lines.japanese: おそらく、この含羞に満ちた甘やかな混乱を、ひとは初恋と呼ぶのでしょう。
lines.english: This sweet confusion, so steeped in bashful shame, is perhaps what mankind calls first love.

lines.japanese: 妙に相手を意識するようになってしまい、ドキドキしたりギクシャクしたり、なんだかとってもヘンテコリンな空気になってしまったのでございます。
lines.english: We became absurdly conscious of one another, our hearts fluttering and our movements stiff, until the very air about us grew most exceedingly peculiar.

lines.japanese: おまけにイブの翌日にはもう叔父さま叔母さまがご帰宅なさったものですから、それはもういろいろな意味でドギマギしてしまったものでございます。
lines.english: And with our honored aunt and uncle returning home the very day after Christmas Eve, we found ourselves in a state of fluster upon fluster, in every conceivable sense.

lines.japanese: テンパったあまり、わたくしの言葉遣いがおかしな具合になってしまうのも致し方なきことかと存じます。
lines.english: Surely I may be forgiven if, under such tremendous strain, my manner of speech also suffered a certain unfortunate transformation.

lines.japanese: それに関しましては、問題の聖夜のあと２～３日がとくに顕著でございました。
lines.english: This condition was at its most pronounced during the two or three days following that fateful holy night.

lines.japanese: 「い、いやあ、やっぱり叔母さんの料理は美味しいなあ、小鳩！」
lines.english: “W-well! Auntie's cooking sure is delicious, isn't it, Kobato?”

lines.japanese: 「え……あっ、うん！　ほんとだね、美味しいねお兄ちゃん！」
lines.english: “Huh...? Oh! Yeah! It's really good, Big Brother!”

lines.japanese: ある日曜の午後、わたくしども家族は、羽田邸のリヴィングでおだやかな昼餉を楽しんでおりました。
lines.english: One Sunday afternoon, we, the family Haneda, were enjoying a tranquil luncheon in the living room of the Haneda residence.

lines.japanese: （まあ、俺が統合したことについて、叔父さん叔母さんとはいろいろ真面目な話もしてるんだが、その辺はまたの機会にでも）
lines.english: (I've also had some serious talks with Uncle and Auntie about becoming whole, but that is a tale for another occasion.)

lines.japanese: 食後ほどなくして叔父さまが早風呂のためバスルウムへと向かわれ、叔母さまはキッチンで食器類の洗浄をお始めになりました。
lines.english: Shortly after our repast, Uncle retired to the bath for an early soak, while Auntie commenced the washing of the dishes in the kitchen.

lines.japanese: テエブルにふたり残されると、わたくしたち兄妹は途端に会話を失つてしまひましたが、さりとて場から立ちさるでもなく、いたづらに刻まれてゆく甘酸つぱひ時にその身を委ねておりました。
lines.english: Left alone together at the table, we siblings were at once bereft of conversation. Yet neither did we take our leave; we merely surrendered ourselves to the sweetly tart passage of time.

lines.japanese: サアアア──、カチャリ。サアア──、カチャリ。
lines.english: Shhhhh—clink. Shhhhh—clink.

lines.japanese: 春の小川にも似たせせらぎと、ときおり川蝉のやうに囀る瀬戸物の音とが溶けあつて、わたくしと小鳩さんのあいだに横たわる沈黙をパステルカラアに染めてあげゆくのです。
lines.english: The murmur of water, like a brook in spring, mingled with the occasional kingfisher chirp of china, tinting the silence stretched between Miss Kobato and myself in pastel hues.

lines.japanese: 「あー、小鳩アレ、冬休みの、しゅく、宿題はいいのか」
lines.english: “S-so, Kobato, what about your... your winter-break homework?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、うん、やる……けど、まだやんない……えへ」
lines.english: “Oh, yeah, I'll do it... just not yet... Heehee.”

lines.japanese: 「はは、そうか、まだやらないのか、ははは」
lines.english: “Ha ha, I see. Not yet, huh? Ha ha ha.”
“Ha ha...”

lines.japanese: わたくしたちはごく自然にふるまふ世間一般的な兄妹たらんとして、かえつて不自然なムウドに包まれてしまふのでありましたが、なぜだかそれさえ居心地の悪い気はいたしませんでした。
lines.english: In our effort to comport ourselves as perfectly ordinary siblings, we instead enveloped ourselves in a most unnatural mood—and yet, somehow, even that did not feel unpleasant.

lines.japanese: 嗚呼、この不思議にスヰートな心地こそ、恋といふものなのでしやう。恋を自重するがゆえ恋を実感するとは、まことに皮肉なものでございます。
lines.english: Ah, this strangely sweet sensation must be that thing called love. How exquisitely ironic, to feel love most keenly precisely because one restrains it.

lines.japanese: 見上げればウヰンドウの向かふで、冬の雀が可愛らしひ電線ダンスなど踊つておりました。
lines.english: I raised my eyes to the window, beyond which a winter sparrow performed an adorable little dance upon a power line.

lines.japanese: 「お、お兄ちゃんは？　じゅけん勉強……」
lines.english: “W-what about you, Big Brother? Your exam studying...”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、勉強な。そうだな、そろそろ行くぞ。まあ、もうちょっと休んだらな」
lines.english: “Right, studying. Yeah, I should get going soon. Maybe after I rest a little longer.”

lines.japanese: 「そうなんだ……もうちょっとって、あと何分ぐらい？」
lines.english: “I see... How many minutes is ‘a little longer’?”

lines.japanese: 「うーん、そうだなあ、まあ、あと５分……いや１０分……いや、小鳩が行くまでいようかな、ははは」
lines.english: “Hmm, let's see. Five more... no, ten... Actually, maybe I'll stay until you leave. Ha ha ha.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？　私はお兄ちゃんが行くまでいるけど」
lines.english: “What? But I was going to stay until you left.”

lines.japanese: 「そっ、そうなんだ、ははは参ったな」
lines.english: “W-were you? Ha ha ha. Well, now we're in a fix.”

lines.japanese: 「えへへ、まいったね」
lines.english: “Heehee. We sure are.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、そうだ、じゃあテレビでも点けて──」
lines.english: “Oh, right. Then why don't we turn on the TV—”

lines.japanese: 「そうだね、それで、いまやってる番組が終わったら──」
lines.english: “Yeah, and when whatever's on right now ends—”

lines.japanese: 嗚呼なんとしたことでしやう。わたくしたちはテレヴィジョンのリモウトコントロウル器へと、揃つて手を伸ばしてしまつたが為、その指と指とが思はぬ接触事故を起こしてしまつたのでござひます。
lines.english: Ah, what twist of fate was this? Both of us reached for the television's remote-control apparatus at once, and thus did our fingers meet in an unforeseen collision.

lines.japanese: 「ご、ごめんなさい……」
lines.english: “S-sorry...”

lines.japanese: 共に目を逸らし、俯ひてしまふ兄妹なのです。
lines.english: Together we averted our eyes, two siblings bowing their heads.

lines.japanese: 「い、いや、こっちこそ悪かった。はは、どうぞどうぞ」
lines.english: “N-no, it was my fault. Ha ha. After you, after you.”

lines.japanese: 「ううん、お兄ちゃんいいよ、どうぞどうぞ」
lines.english: “No, that's okay, Big Brother. After you.”

lines.japanese: 「いやいや、小鳩いいから。好きな番組をどうぞどうぞ」
lines.english: “No, no, I insist, Kobato. Pick whatever show you like.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなそんな、ぜんぜん、お兄ちゃんこそ、どうぞどう──」
lines.english: “Oh, no, no, really. You should choose, Big Brother, please—”

lines.japanese: 「ひあっ！」
lines.english: “Eep!”

lines.japanese: 両者の譲る気持ちが前へ前へと逸つてしまひ、ふたたび指先が触れあつてしまひました。
lines.english: So eager were we both to yield that we thrust our hands forward once more, and our fingertips met a second time.

lines.japanese: 「ご、ごめんなさ──」
lines.english: “S-sor—”

lines.japanese: 今度はおもてを上げた拍子に、目と目がぶつかつてしまひますれば、なおもぢもぢと縮こまるわたくしたちなのでござひました。
lines.english: And when we raised our faces only for our eyes to collide as well, we shrank in upon ourselves, fidgeting ever more helplessly.

lines.japanese: と、まあそんな感じで、しばらくアレな雰囲気だったわけだ。
lines.english: So, yeah. Things were like that between us for a while.

lines.japanese: いや、そりゃね？　よく考えたらね？　べつに俺たちじゃなくてもね？
lines.english: I mean, you know? When you really think about it? This wouldn't have been easy for anybody, right?

lines.japanese: 年ごろの男女がいちど面と向かって告白してしまった以上、ひとまずなかったことにしましょうと言われても（いや、言ったの俺だけど）そうあっさりと元のふたりには戻れるはずがなかったよね。
lines.english: Once a boy and girl our age had confessed to each other's faces, there was no way they could instantly go back to normal just because somebody said, “Let's pretend that never happened.” (Yes, that somebody was me.)

lines.japanese: おまけに俺たちの場合はひとつ屋根の下に暮らす家族、しかも両想いでありながら自重せねばならないという、なんとも微妙な立場に置かれているのだ。
lines.english: And in our case, we were family living under one roof, mutually in love yet obliged to hold ourselves back. It put us in one hell of an awkward position.

lines.japanese: たとえば年頃の兄妹として、対外的にどういう距離感を保つべきなのか、計りあぐねたりもした。
lines.english: We couldn't even work out how much distance we ought to keep in public as a brother and sister our age.

lines.japanese: あれは柳木原に雪が降った日。
lines.english: There was one day when snow fell over Yanagihara.

lines.japanese: いちおう受験組である俺は、冬期講習のため登校していた。
lines.english: I was supposed to be preparing for college entrance exams, so I’d gone to school for winter classes.

lines.japanese: いつもとは違う教室に集められて、自習中心のプログラムをこなし、ぼちぼちお開きという頃合。
lines.english: They gathered us in a classroom we didn't usually use and put us through a mostly self-study program. Just as things were about to wrap up,

lines.japanese: 同じクラスの鴻野君らが、窓際に寄って騒ぎだしていた。
lines.english: Kono and some other guys from my class crowded around the window and started making a racket.

lines.japanese: 「なあ、あの校門のトコいる小っちゃい子、誰だよ」
lines.english: “Hey, who's that little girl by the school gate?”

lines.japanese: 「この辺でセーラー服ったら、アオ女の付属だよな」
lines.english: “A sailor uniform around here? Gotta be from the Azure Sky affiliate.”

lines.japanese: 俺は頻出問題のチェック（する振り）をしながら、注意深く耳をそばだてていた。
lines.english: I kept a careful ear on them while pretending to review frequently tested material.

lines.japanese: 彼らが噂している対象は分かる。うちの小鳩だ。
lines.english: I knew who they were talking about. My Kobato.

lines.japanese: 朝、教室に着いたころ、俺の携帯電話が鳴ったのだ。
lines.english: My phone had rung around the time I reached the classroom that morning.

lines.japanese: 『あ、あの、もしもし』
lines.english: “Um, hello?”

lines.japanese: 発信者は公衆電話からだったが、出てみると妹だった。
lines.english: The call came from a pay phone, but the person on the other end was my sister.

lines.japanese: いわく、兄が家の鍵を忘れていったので、学校まで届けに行くという。
lines.english: She said her brother had left his house key behind, so she was going to bring it to his school.

lines.japanese: 「いや、いいよ、べつに鍵ぐらい急がないし」
lines.english: “No, it's fine. I don't need the key right away.”

lines.japanese: 俺がどこかで時間を潰して、羽田家の誰かよりあとに帰宅すれば済むだけの話だ。
lines.english: All I had to do was kill time somewhere and get home after somebody else in the Haneda household.

lines.japanese: と言ってやりたかったのだが、駅から掛けてきたらしい彼女はせわしかった。
lines.english: That was what I wanted to tell her, but she sounded rushed; apparently she was calling from the station.

lines.japanese: 『でも、私もお母さんもきょう帰り遅いし……ふわあっ！　ごご、ごめん電車きちゃった、それじゃあとで、校門の前で待ってる』
lines.english: “But Mom and I are both getting home late today, and... Whoa! S-sorry, my train's here! I'll see you later. I'll wait by the school gate.”

lines.japanese: いや待て、しかもこんな足元の悪い日に外で待ち合わせって。そこだけでも改めさせたかったが、電話は一方的に切れた。
lines.english: Wait, hold on. Meeting outside on a day when the ground was this bad? I at least wanted to change that part of the plan, but she hung up on me.

lines.japanese: そしてケータイ未所持の彼女に、連絡するすべはなかった。
lines.english: And since she didn't own a cell phone, I had no way to reach her.

lines.japanese: 「それにしても寒そうだな、あの子……誰だよ、こんな日に外で待ち合わせしたの」
lines.english: “She sure looks cold... Who makes somebody wait outside on a day like this?”

lines.japanese: えっ、いや、俺じゃナイヨ？
lines.english: Huh? N-no, that wasn't me.

lines.japanese: 「でも、あの健気な雰囲気はいいよな。絵になるっつーか」
lines.english: “Still, there's something nice about how devoted she looks. Like a picture or something.”

lines.japanese: く、くそっ、俺も早く見たいぞ。教師、早く戻ってこい。
lines.english: D-damn it, I wanted to see her too. Hurry up and come back, teacher.

lines.japanese: 「つーか遠目で見たカンジ、結構カオも可愛いんじゃね？」
lines.english: “From this far away, looks like she's got a pretty cute face too, doesn't she?”

lines.japanese: む、鋭いな鴻野君。ちなみに近間で見れば結構どころの騒ぎじゃないぞ。
lines.english: Sharp eyes, Kono. And believe me, up close, “pretty cute” doesn't begin to cover it.

lines.japanese: 「彼氏でも迎えに来たンかな」
lines.english: “Think she's here to meet her boyfriend?”

lines.japanese: ふふ、当たらずとも遠からずと言ったところだ。
lines.english: Heh. Not exactly wrong.

lines.japanese: 「あんまそういうカンジの子には見えないけどな」
lines.english: “She doesn't really look like that kind of girl.”

lines.japanese: うむ、うちの小鳩は天使のように清らかだからな。
lines.english: Indeed. My Kobato was as pure as an angel.

lines.japanese: 「いや、あーゆーのに限って遊んでンだって。ひょっとしたらウリとかエンコーとかしてンじゃねえの」
lines.english: “Nah, those are the ones who get around. Maybe she sells it or goes on compensated dates.”

lines.japanese: ぎりぎりぎり……思わず手にしていたマーカーペンに力がこもってしまった。
lines.english: Creeeak... My grip tightened around the marker in my hand.

lines.japanese: くっ、無礼きわまる下民め。覚えておれ、地味に報復してやるぞ。
lines.english: You insolent peasant. Remember this day. I would have my petty revenge.

lines.japanese: だが、いまは騒ぎを大きくしたくない。彼女の正体が、学園一のカリスマ男子の妹だと知れたら、なおさら奇異の目に晒されてしまう。
lines.english: But I didn't want to make a scene now. If people found out she was the little sister of the most charismatic boy in school, she would only attract even more curious stares.

lines.japanese: 「つーか、うちの学校に兄貴がいて、忘れ物でも届けに来たんじゃねえの」
lines.english: “Maybe her brother goes here and she's bringing him something he forgot.”

lines.japanese: ぎくっ！
lines.english: Ghk!

lines.japanese: 「おい、羽田も見てみろって。おまえ、妹キャラとか好きだったろ」
lines.english: “Hey, Haneda, come look. You were into the little-sister type, weren't you?”

lines.japanese: 「はあ？　べつに興味ないけど」
lines.english: “Huh? Not interested.”

lines.japanese: いきなり話を振られたが、俺は冷静を装った。
lines.english: Put on the spot, I pretended to remain calm.

lines.japanese: 「なんだよ羽田、他人の妹には興味ナシかよ。自分トコの妹はさんざん持ちあげるくせに」
lines.english: “What, Haneda? Other guys' sisters do nothing for you? You never shut up about your own.”

lines.japanese: 「あんなのはネタだって。本気で褒めちぎってるわけじゃないよ。べつに俺、シスコンとかロリコンとか全然ないしね」
lines.english: “That's just a bit. I don't seriously worship the ground she walks on. I don't have a sister complex or a Lolita complex or anything.”

lines.japanese: 「そーなん？　じゃあ神が作った至高の芸術とか言ってたのも嘘なん？」
lines.english: “Yeah? So all that stuff about ‘God's crowning achievement’ was a lie?”

lines.japanese: 「当たり前だろう。そんな世迷いごと本気でほざく兄がいたら相当キモいぞ」
lines.english: “Obviously. Any brother who sincerely spouted nonsense like that would be a total creep.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ああ、そうだったんだ……よかった、俺若干キモいと思ってたわ……」
lines.english: “O-oh. So that's what it was... Good. I kind of thought you were a creep...”

lines.japanese: 「でもさあ？　もし自分の妹が、あの校門トコの女の子ぐらい可愛いかったら、まあ自慢したくはなるんだろうな」
lines.english: “But, hey, if my own sister were as cute as the girl at the gate, I guess I'd want to show her off too.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、それはたしかに」
lines.english: “Yeah, fair point.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、おまえ見てないじゃん」
lines.english: “You haven't even looked at her.”

lines.japanese: 「なんつーか、佇まいからして可愛いよな。寒い中、手ぇこすりながらハァーって息吹きかけてンのとか」
lines.english: “Even the way she's standing there is cute, you know? Rubbing her hands in the cold and blowing on them...”

lines.japanese: 「分かる分かる。テンション上がるよな」
lines.english: “Yeah, yeah, I get it. Really gets you going.”

lines.japanese: 「だから、おまえ見てないじゃん」
lines.english: “You still haven't looked at her.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、なんか、すっげ気になってきたな。下おりて、もっと近くで見てみっか」
lines.english: “Aw, man, now I'm dying to know. Wanna head down and get a closer look?”

lines.japanese: 「つーか、声かけてみようぜ。ああいう子は欲求不満だから、意外とナンパされたがってたりすンだよ」
lines.english: “Hell, let's go talk to her. Girls like that are sexually frustrated. Bet she's secretly hoping somebody'll pick her up.”

lines.japanese: 「ハハ、やめとけって。そろそろ先生戻ってくるぞ」
lines.english: “Ha ha, knock it off. Teacher'll be back soon.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そうか」
lines.english: “Oh, right.”

lines.japanese: 俺はこぶしを震わせながらも、爪が皮膚を食いやぶるほどの忍耐力を要して堪えた。
lines.english: My fists trembled, but I held myself back, digging my nails into my skin.

lines.japanese: 「やっべぇー、俺まだ課題終わってなかったわァ」
lines.english: “Crap, I still haven't finished the assignment.”

lines.japanese: 彼らがのろのろと席へ戻ってゆく。俺は血の味のする唇を噛みしめながら、わななく手でマーカーのキャップを閉めた。
lines.english: They shuffled back to their seats. Biting my lip hard enough to taste blood, I capped the marker with a shaking hand.

lines.japanese: 「うわあっ！　だっ、誰だよ、俺のノートのぜんぜん重要じゃないとこにアンダーライン引きまくったの！」
lines.english: “Whoa! W-who underlined all the completely unimportant parts of my notes?!”

lines.japanese: 補習が終わったあと、慌てて小鳩のもとへ走った。
lines.english: As soon as the extra class ended, I rushed off to meet Kobato.

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃん……」
lines.english: “Big Brother...”

lines.japanese: 寒さと緊張で硬くなっていた小鳩の表情に、温かい笑みと白い吐息が広がった。
lines.english: Her face, stiff from cold and nerves, softened into a warm smile and a cloud of white breath.

lines.japanese: 「お、おうっ」
lines.english: “H-hey.”

lines.japanese: そして相変わらず、ふたり面と向かいあえば、あの妙な初恋空間に引きこまれてしまうのでございます。
lines.english: And, as ever, the moment we stood face-to-face, we were drawn back into that peculiar realm of first love.

lines.japanese: 「お、おつ、おつかれさまー……なんて、えへ」
lines.english: “G-good... Good work today... Heehee.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、いや、ハハ……ごめんな、こんなとこで待たせちゃって。寒かったろ」
lines.english: “Ah, ha ha... Sorry I made you wait out here. You must be freezing.”

lines.japanese: 「へーき。ちょうどいま来たとこだから」
lines.english: “I'm fine. I only just got here.”

lines.japanese: 小鳩さんの温かな嘘は、冬の厳しい寒さをひととき忘れさせてくれるのです。
lines.english: Miss Kobato's tender lie made me forget the cruel winter cold for one blessed moment.

lines.japanese: 「買ったばっかりのマフラーも大かつやく。えへへ」
lines.english: “This new scarf is really earning its keep, too. Heehee.”

lines.japanese: 「そっか……ありがとな」
lines.english: “I see... Thanks.”

lines.japanese: わたくしは彼女の艶やかな黒髪にそっと手を置いて、感謝と親愛の意を表しました。
lines.english: I gently placed my hand upon her lustrous black hair, conveying both gratitude and affection.

lines.japanese: 「よく似合ってるよ。可愛いし、あったかそうだ」
lines.english: “It looks good on you. It's cute, and it looks warm.”

lines.japanese: 首元を覆っていたマフラァを、きゅっと結びなおしてさしあげながら、優しい兄の声で。
lines.english: So spoke the tender elder brother as he snugly retied the scarf about her neck.

lines.japanese: 「部活、抜けだして来てくれたんだろ。今度は俺が小鳩の学校まで送るよ」
lines.english: “You slipped out of club to bring this, didn't you? This time, I'll walk you back to your school.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ！？　い、いいよ、だいじょぶだよ──」
lines.english: “What?! N-no, it's okay, I'll be fine—”

lines.japanese: 「──あ、でも、どうしよ。うそ、やっぱり、だいじょぶじゃないかも」
lines.english: “—Oh, but what should I do? Um, actually, maybe I won't be fine after all.”

lines.japanese: 慌てふためいて訂正する様が、とても愛らしいのでございます。
lines.english: How exceedingly adorable she was, hastily correcting herself so.

lines.japanese: 「お、送って、もらっちゃおうかなっ……なんて、えへ」
lines.english: “M-maybe I will let you walk me back... Heehee.”

lines.japanese: 「は、はは、そんな遠慮すんなって。そうだ小鳩、腹へってないか」
lines.english: “H-ha ha. You don't have to be shy about it. Oh, right. Are you hungry, Kobato?”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、うん……べつに、どっちでもいいよ」
lines.english: “Oh, um... I don't mind either way.”

lines.japanese: 「はは、どっちでもって。俺は腹が減ってないかって聞いたんだぞ」
lines.english: “Ha ha. ‘Either way’? I asked if you were hungry.”

lines.japanese: お優しい小鳩さんですから、きっと食事処へ行くや行かざるやの選択権を、わたくしに譲りたかったのでございましょう。
lines.english: Ever considerate, Miss Kobato had surely meant to leave the decision of whether or not to dine entirely in my hands.

lines.japanese: その細やかな心配りに感激し、食せずとも胸いっぱいになるわたくしでありました。
lines.english: So deeply was I moved by her delicate thoughtfulness that my heart felt full even though my stomach remained empty.

lines.japanese: 「俺のことは気にしなくていいから、小鳩の腹具合はどうなんだ？」
lines.english: “Don't worry about me. How hungry are you, Kobato?”

lines.japanese: 「うんとね、うーんと……ふつー」
lines.english: “Ummm... normal.”

lines.japanese: すなわち「どっちでもいいよ」と同義でございます。わたくしの都合に準ずるということでございます。
lines.english: Which was to say, “I don't mind either way.” Her answer would conform to whatever suited me.

lines.japanese: 頑なとさえ言えるその健気さに、なお胸が締めつけられるわたくしでありました。
lines.english: My heart constricted further at such touching—and almost obstinate—devotion.

lines.japanese: 「そ、それじゃあ、その普通っていうのは、空腹か満腹かどっち寄りの普通なんだ？」
lines.english: “W-well, then, does ‘normal’ mean normal leaning toward hungry or normal leaning toward full?”

lines.japanese: 「うーん……」
lines.english: “Ummm...”

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃんとおんなじ」
lines.english: “The same as you, Big Brother.”

lines.japanese: あくまでもご自身よりわたくしの意思を尊重したいという、その殊勝な御心にはもはや感涙すら催します。喉の奥から込みあげる熱いものを、懸命に堪えねばなりませんでした。
lines.english: Her admirable desire to honor my wishes over her own now moved me nearly to tears. I had to struggle mightily against the hot emotion rising in my throat.

lines.japanese: 「あ、あの、でも……ちょっとだけ、わがまま言っていい？」
lines.english: “Um, but... can I be just a little selfish?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ああ、どうした」
lines.english: “S-sure. What is it?”

lines.japanese: 「あのね……ほんとはちょっと、お兄ちゃんとごはん食べたいかも……なんて、えへ」
lines.english: “Well... I think maybe I really do want to eat with you, Big Brother... Heehee.”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そうか、ハハ……」
lines.english: “I-I see. Ha ha...”

lines.japanese: 嗚呼、もはや限界。わたくしは涙の零れるまま、彼女をギュウと抱きしめてしまいたい衝動に駆られ──
lines.english: Ah, I could bear it no longer. Tears welled in my eyes, and I was seized by the urge to clasp her tightly to my bosom—

lines.japanese: 「はァ～ねだ～」
lines.english: “Haneeedaaa.”

lines.japanese: 「げえっ、鴻野君のひと！」
lines.english: “Gah! Kono and his people!”

lines.japanese: いつもはすぐに帰らず、教室に残ってだらだら掃除具野球などしているはずのクラスメイトたちが、にやにや下卑た笑いを携えてわたくしの──俺の背後に立っていやがった。
lines.english: My classmates—who usually loitered after school playing improvised baseball with the cleaning supplies—stood behind me with filthy grins on their faces.

lines.japanese: 「なーんか怪しいと思ったらよォ。やーっぱこーゆーことですかァ、お兄ちゃん」
lines.english: “Knew something was fishy. So thaaat's what this is, huh, Big Brother?”

lines.japanese: くっ、不覚……尾けられていたのか。
lines.english: Damn. I'd let my guard down... They followed me.

lines.japanese: 「い、いやあ、驚いたなあ！　まさかうちの妹がこんなところにいたなんてえ！」
lines.english: “W-wow, what a surprise! Who could have guessed my sister would be all the way out here?”

lines.japanese: だが俺はシラを切った。
lines.english: But I played dumb.

lines.japanese: 「かわいいねー、お兄ちゃんと似ないでよかったねー」
lines.english: “Aren't you adorable? Good thing you don't look like your brother.”

lines.japanese: だが誰も聞いていなかった。
lines.english: No one was listening.

lines.japanese: 「羽田なに子ちゃん？　彼氏とかいんの？」
lines.english: “So what's your name, little Miss Haneda? Got a boyfriend?”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？　あ、あやっ、あの……」
lines.english: “What? I-I, um...”

lines.japanese: 「恐がらないで大丈夫よ、どっか遊び行く？」
lines.english: “Don't be scared. Wanna go hang out somewhere?”

lines.japanese: 「は、羽田小鳩と申します！　兄がいつもおせわになってますっ！」
lines.english: “M-my name is Kobato Haneda! Thank you for always looking after my brother!”

lines.japanese: 冗談かと思うぐらい深々と頭を下げる小鳩。
lines.english: Kobato bowed so deeply I almost thought it was a joke.

lines.japanese: 「そ、それではっ」
lines.english: “N-now, if you'll excuse me!”

lines.japanese: そして走りだしてしまった。
lines.english: Then she ran away.

lines.japanese: 「かーわいい、逃げちゃったよ。チクショいいなあ羽田、あんな妹いて」
lines.english: “So cute. We scared her off. Damn, Haneda, lucky bastard, having a sister like that.”

lines.japanese: 「べ、べつに、あのぐらい普通だろ。そんな俺、シスコンとかロリコンとか全然ないしね」
lines.english: “Sh-she's average. Nothing special. I don't have a sister complex or a Lolita complex or anything.”

lines.japanese: 「ホントかあ？　あんな可愛い子と毎日一緒にいたら、たまにはヘンな気分になんだろ？」
lines.english: “Seriously? Living with a girl that cute every day doesn't ever put funny ideas in your head?”

lines.japanese: 「ばっ、ばばば馬鹿なことおっしゃるんじゃありませんよ。だって俺、シスコンとかロリコンとか全然ないし、ほら、いまも逃げてった妹をマッハで追いかけたりとかしてないだろ」
lines.english: “D-d-don't be ridiculous, sir! I don't have a sister complex or a Lolita complex at all. See? I'm not even chasing my fleeing sister at Mach speed as we speak.”

lines.japanese: 「ピー、ピー」
lines.english: “Beep, beep.”

lines.japanese: 「おっといけない、来日中の国防総省長官と怪獣ごっこの時間じゃないか。それじゃあ君たち、さようなら。あ、べつに俺、逃げてった妹をマッハで追いかけるとか全然ないけどね」
lines.english: “Oh dear, is it time already for my game of giant monsters with the visiting US Secretary of Defense? Farewell, gentlemen. And no, I am absolutely not about to pursue my fleeing sister at Mach speed.”

lines.japanese: で、そのあと音速並みの早歩きで小鳩を追いかけ、無事に彼女とデート……もとい、昼メシを共にして学校まで送りとどけたわけだが。
lines.english: After that, I speed-walked after Kobato at nearly the speed of sound and enjoyed a successful date... I mean, shared lunch with her and walked her back to school.

lines.japanese: そして、この話には後日談があって。
lines.english: And there was an epilogue to the story.

lines.japanese: 「お、お兄ちゃんっ」
lines.english: “B-Big Brother!”

lines.japanese: 「こ、これっ、良かったら使ってください！」
lines.english: “P-please use this, if you'd like!”

lines.japanese: なんといふことでしやう。小鳩さんはわたくしのために、手編みのマフラアをこしらえてくださったのでございます。
lines.english: What wonder was this? Miss Kobato had knitted a scarf for me with her very own hands.

lines.japanese: 「え……な、なんで……」
lines.english: “What...? Wh-why...?”

lines.japanese: 「だめですかっ」
lines.english: “Don't you want it?”

lines.japanese: 「まさか！　そうじゃなくて、なんでこんな……」
lines.english: “Of course I do! I just mean, why did you...?”

lines.japanese: 「こないだ、マフラーあったかそうって言ってたから」
lines.english: “Because the other day, you said my scarf looked warm.”

lines.japanese: 申しあげたやうな、申しあげておらぬやうな、わたくしに取りてはその程度の記憶にござひます。
lines.english: I might have said such a thing, or I might not; to me it was a memory of no greater consequence than that.

lines.japanese: わたくし自身でさえうろ覚えの曖昧な言葉を、しかし、お優しい小鳩さんは真剣に受けとめていらしたのです。
lines.english: And yet kind Miss Kobato had taken in earnest even those vague words which I myself could scarcely recall.

lines.japanese: 「ありが、とう……」
lines.english: “Thank... you...”

lines.japanese: 呆然たる想ひにあれば、心ココニ非ズの態になりけり。
lines.english: So dumbfounded was I that my body stood present while my wits wandered afar.

lines.japanese: 「さ、差し出がましい真似をしてすみませんっ」
lines.english: “I'm sorry I was so presumptuous!”

lines.japanese: 「そんなわけないって」
lines.english: “You weren't, not at all.”

lines.japanese: 小鳩さんの仰々しきお言葉遣ひは、かえって稚く、なお可愛らしく思へるのです。
lines.english: Miss Kobato's grandly formal manner of speech only made her seem younger and more adorable still.

lines.japanese: 「本当にありがとう。大事に使わせてもらうよ。いや、使うの勿体ないかな」
lines.english: “Thank you. Really. I'll treasure it. Though maybe it would be a waste to actually wear it.”

lines.japanese: 「いっしょうけんめい作ったので、できれば使ってほしいです！」
lines.english: “I worked really hard on it, so I would like you to wear it, please!”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、そうだな」
lines.english: “Yeah. You're right.”

lines.japanese: 「とてもうれしいです！」
lines.english: “That makes me very happy!”

lines.japanese: 勿体ないわたくしなどは、その数倍うれしい心地にて候。
lines.english: And unworthy though I was, I felt several times happier still.

lines.japanese: そしてカチコチと緊張したる様の小鳩さんは、夜が明けるまで、そのお言葉遣ひのままお過ごしになるのでござひました。
lines.english: And stiff with nerves as she was, Miss Kobato continued to speak in that ceremonious fashion until dawn broke.

lines.japanese: ふたりで歩いたりするときも、以前とはなんだか違う空気だった。
lines.english: Even walking together felt somehow different now.

lines.japanese: たとえばデート……もとい、叔母さんに用事を頼まれて、柳木原へ出かけたときのこと。
lines.english: Take the day we went on a date... I mean, ran an errand for Auntie in Yanagihara.

lines.japanese: 彼女は俺の真横ではなく、真横から微妙に下がって並ぶ。角度にしてわずか十数度の後方。
lines.english: Instead of walking directly beside me, she kept just a touch behind. Barely more than ten degrees back from my side.

lines.japanese: 「えへへ」
lines.english: “Heehee.”

lines.japanese: 首をひねらなくても普通に会話はできる。視界の端で姿も確認できる。
lines.english: We could talk normally without my having to turn my head. I could even see her at the edge of my vision.

lines.japanese: けれど完全に前を注視してしまうと視野から消える、八時の方向。
lines.english: But if I focused straight ahead, she vanished from sight: the eight-o'clock position.

lines.japanese: 後ろではなく、ほんの少しずれた隣り。そこが小鳩のお気に入りポジションみたいだ。
lines.english: Not behind me, just a step off to one side. That seemed to be Kobato's favorite spot.

lines.japanese: その位置をキープして、小鳩がてこてこ付いてくる。
lines.english: She held that position and pattered along after me.

lines.japanese: なんか仔犬みたい……と言ったら怒られるだろうか。
lines.english: Just like a puppy... Would she get mad if I said that?

lines.japanese: てこてこてこ。
lines.english: Pitter-patter, pitter-patter.

lines.japanese: どこまでも付いてくる。
lines.english: She followed me everywhere.

lines.japanese: てこてこてこ。
lines.english: Pitter-patter, pitter-patter.

lines.japanese: どこまでも。
lines.english: Everywhere I went.

lines.japanese: てこてこてこ。
lines.english: Pitter-patter, pitter-patter.

lines.japanese: どこまでも──
lines.english: Everywhere—

lines.japanese: ──いや、どこまでもじゃなくて。
lines.english: —Actually, not everywhere.

lines.japanese: 「あの、俺、トイレ行くんだけど……」
lines.english: “Um, I'm going to the men's room...”

lines.japanese: 「うあっ、間違えました！」
lines.english: “Ah! My mistake!”

lines.japanese: トイレから出てくると、小鳩の姿はすこし離れたところにあった。
lines.english: When I came out, Kobato was standing a short distance away.

lines.japanese: 暇を持てあましてか、ケータイショップの一画を外からじっと眺めている。
lines.english: Perhaps for want of anything else to do, she was staring through the window at one corner of a cell phone store.

lines.japanese: もしかしたら、そろそろ携帯電話のひとつも持ちたいお年頃なのかもしれない。
lines.english: Maybe she'd reached the age when a person started wanting a cell phone of her own.

lines.japanese: うふふ、しからばこの頼れる兄が、いっちょ最新機種でもプレゼントしてあげようかしらん──
lines.english: Ho ho, then perhaps this dependable elder brother shall present her with the very latest model—

lines.japanese: ──とか思いながら財布を開ければ、ぐぬぬ、これっぽちじゃ糸と紙コップしか買えんではないか。
lines.english: —or so I thought, until I opened my wallet. Grrr. This wouldn't buy anything more advanced than two cups and a piece of string.

lines.japanese: 小鳩の為とはいえ、さすがに医療以外の目的で貯金は崩せないし、仕方ない、明日からちょっとバイトを増やすか。
lines.english: Even for Kobato, I couldn't dip into my savings for anything but medical expenses. Fine, then. I would just take on a little more work starting tomorrow.

lines.japanese: いまでもアレキサンダーでのバイトは続けてるけど、それだけじゃ足りないから、ヒゲカンの現場仕事や、米田優関連の書きモノ仕事を再開して──
lines.english: I still had my job at Alexander, but that wouldn't be enough. I could resume taking construction jobs from Higekan and writing assignments connected to Yuu Yoneda—

lines.japanese: ──っとと、いまはそんなこと考えてる場合じゃない、寂しがり屋の小鳩を待たせてるんだった。
lines.english: —Wait, this wasn't the time to think about that. I'd left lonely little Kobato waiting.

lines.japanese: よし、懸念事項はいったん脇に置いて、いっちょテンション上げていこうか。
lines.english: All right. Concerns set aside. Time to liven things up.

lines.japanese: 俺は幼稚ないたずら心に駆られ、彼女の背後へそろりそろりと抜き足で近付いていった。
lines.english: Seized by a childish urge to tease her, I crept toward her from behind, step by stealthy step.

lines.japanese: とんとん。
lines.english: Tap, tap.

lines.japanese: 「ふぇ？」
lines.english: “Hmm?”

lines.japanese: 後ろから肩を叩いたその直後、ふたつの手のひらで目を覆う。
lines.english: I tapped her shoulder from behind, then immediately put both hands up as a blindfold.

lines.japanese: 「だーれだっ？」
lines.english: “Guess who?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、お帰りなさいお兄ちゃん」
lines.english: “Oh, welcome back, Big Brother.”

lines.japanese: 「はっずれ～！　答えはみんな大好きハンサム王子でした～」
lines.english: “Wrooong! It was everybody's favorite handsome prince!”

lines.japanese: 「てゆうか、自分で自分を目かくししてもクイズにならないよ」
lines.english: “Except covering your own eyes doesn't make much of a guessing game.”

lines.japanese: 「アッ！　いっけね、間違えちゃった～☆」
lines.english: “Whoops! Silly me! I did it wrooong! ☆”

lines.japanese: 「あはは」
lines.english: “Ah ha ha.”

lines.japanese: よしよし、こんなレトロ駄ギャグで場が和むぐらいだから、だいぶ元に戻ってきたぞ。
lines.english: Good, good. If a corny antique of a joke could ease the mood, we really were getting back to normal.

lines.japanese: 例のむず痒い初恋空間──俺たちをどぎまぎさせるおかしな空気も、日の経過とともにその濃度は薄まりつつあった。
lines.english: That ticklish realm of first love—the strange air that left us both flustered—had slowly thinned as the days passed.

lines.japanese: 「いや、ほら、せっかくふたりでこんな所に来たんだから、恋人ごっこでもしておこうと思ってな」
lines.english: “I mean, since we came all this way together, I thought we might as well play at being lovers.”

lines.japanese: 避けて回っていた二文字を、あえておふざけの中に盛りこんでみる。
lines.english: I deliberately slipped that loaded word into the joke after we'd spent so long avoiding it.

lines.japanese: 「え？　えっ、えへ、そんな、ちょっと恥ずかしいよ……」
lines.english: “What? Wha—heehee, no, that's kind of embarrassing...”

lines.japanese: 照れりこ照れりこと、身をよじりながら頬を染める小鳩。
lines.english: Blushity-blush, squirmity-squirm went Kobato, twisting about with reddened cheeks.

lines.japanese: うーん、俺はだいぶ慣れてきたんだけど、小鳩の方はまだまだ意識しちゃうみたいだな。
lines.english: Hmm. I'd mostly gotten used to it, but Kobato still seemed awfully conscious of the whole thing.

lines.japanese: しかしシケギャグかますたびに、いちいちそんな可愛い反応されてたら、こっちの理性が持たないぞ。
lines.english: But if every dud joke I made got a reaction that cute, my self-control wasn't going to last.

lines.japanese: よし、ちょっと荒療治だ。
lines.english: All right, time for some shock therapy.

lines.japanese: 「さ、行こうぜハニー」
lines.english: “Come along, honey.”

lines.japanese: 恋人ごっこの延長として、ちょっと乱暴に肩を抱いてみた。
lines.english: Carrying the lovers-at-play routine a step further, I threw an arm roughly around her shoulders.

lines.japanese: 「うえっ！？」
lines.english: “Wha?!”

lines.japanese: 「な、なんだよ、そんな驚かなくてもいいだろ」
lines.english: “Wh-what? You don't have to act that surprised.”

lines.japanese: 嫌がられたのかと思って、一瞬傷付いちゃったじゃないか。
lines.english: For a second there, I thought she was rejecting me. It kind of hurt.

lines.japanese: 「え、でも、だって、こういうのは……」
lines.english: “But, um, this is...”

lines.japanese: 思いのほか小さい小鳩の体が、腕の中で身じろぎしたあと──
lines.english: Kobato's surprisingly small body shifted within my arm, and then—
“...Is this okay?”

lines.japanese: ──はにかむように問う。
lines.english: —she asked with a bashful smile.

lines.japanese: 「うっ」
lines.english: “Urk.”

lines.japanese: 存外に感じいり頬を染めたるそのさまに、わたくしのハアトがドキリと高鳴ってしまったのでございます。
lines.english: Her unexpectedly moved and blushing countenance set my heart to pounding within my breast.

lines.japanese: これまさに、ミイラ取りがミイラとなる由にて御座候。
lines.english: Thus had the mummy hunter himself become a mummy.

lines.japanese: しかし、わたくしは平静を装ひて申しあげました。
lines.english: Nevertheless, I feigned composure and declared,

lines.japanese: 「い、いいんだよ。だってコレはほら、ごっこだから」
lines.english: “I-it's fine. This is only make-believe, remember?”

lines.japanese: 「な、なるほどです」
lines.english: “I-I see.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、だって、べつに特別な……何ていうの？　あの……イチャイチャとかラブラブとか、そうゆんじゃないからねコレ」
lines.english: “Right. There's nothing special about it... How do I put this? We're not being all lovey-dovey or anything.”

lines.japanese: 「まあ俺、妹の肩抱いたぐらいでそんな、ドキドキとかウキウキとか全然ないし。うん、あったらまずいけど、このぐらいは余裕でアレだし。こんなん小鳩だって楽勝でアレだろ」
lines.english: “I mean, just putting my arm around my sister doesn't have me all excited or giddy. That'd be bad. This is totally, you know, whatever. It's gotta be a total whatever for you too, right?”

lines.japanese: 「え……あっ、そう、アレだね。あの、もう、すっごいアレだよ。かんぜんに合法だよ」
lines.english: “Oh... Yeah, right, whatever. It's super whatever. Completely legal.”

lines.japanese: さうしてわたくしたち兄妹は、かりそめの恋人同士がごとく身を寄りそへ、世のアベックらにて賑わふ雑踏のうちへ溶けこんでゆくのでござひました。
lines.english: And thus did we siblings nestle close like lovers in masquerade, melting into the throng of couples that filled the bustling streets.

lines.japanese: 「あれ……そういや俺、便所から出て、手ぇ洗ったっけ？」
lines.english: “Wait... Did I wash my hands after I used the bathroom?”

lines.japanese: 「ぎゃあああ！」
lines.english: “Aaaaaah!”

lines.japanese: 恋人ごっこは一分を待たず終了した。
lines.english: Our lovers-at-play routine ended in under a minute.

lines.japanese: それがきっかけだったかは定かじゃないが──
lines.english: I can't say for certain whether that was what did it, but—

lines.japanese: ──長い冬休みのあいだ、そんなようなドキドキとズッコケを幾度も繰りかえすうち、やがて俺たちは元の俺たちへと自然に戻っていった。
lines.english: —over the long winter break, as thrills and pratfalls like those played out again and again, we naturally found our way back to being ourselves.

lines.japanese: まもなく三学期。
lines.english: The third term was almost here.

lines.japanese: 俺たち受験組は、もうガチガチの授業もほとんどない。場合によっては自主休校だって許される。消化試合みたいなユルい学園生活だ。
lines.english: We college applicants barely had any rigidly scheduled classes left. Depending on the circumstances, we were even allowed to stay home and study. School life had gone slack, like a game whose outcome was already decided.

lines.japanese: だからってハメを外しすぎれば、三月あたりにサクラ散るという結果で自分へ返ってくるわけだが……
lines.english: Of course, if we slacked off too much, we’d pay for it with failed entrance exams come March...

lines.japanese: しかし、それはそれとして胸が躍る。
lines.english: Even so, my heart leaped at the thought.

lines.japanese: 明日は冬休み最終日。そのあとはいよいよ薔薇色の学園生活、再開。
lines.english: Tomorrow was the last day of winter break. After that, my rose-colored school days would finally begin anew.

lines.japanese: なあ、おまえも楽しみだろ？
lines.english: You're looking forward to it too, aren't you?

lines.japanese: 「お兄ちゃん！　にやにやしてないで、早くごはん食べてって」
lines.english: “Big Brother! Quit grinning and hurry up and eat!”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、すまんすまん。いまちょっと、世話になった友人と再会したもんでな」
lines.english: “Sorry, sorry. I just happened to run into an old friend who's helped me out a lot.”

lines.japanese: 「もおー、またそんなことゆってー。ぜんぜん反省してなーい」
lines.english: “Oh, come on. You're doing it again. You're not sorry at all.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、違うんだ。こうして小鳩に怒られてる瞬間さえ、俺は楽しくて仕方がないんだ」
lines.english: “No, you don't understand. Even this very moment, with Kobato scolding me, is so much fun I can hardly stand it.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、生きてるって素晴らしいな。毎日が薔薇色だもんな」
lines.english: “Ah, what a wonderful thing it is to be alive. Every day is coming up roses.”

lines.japanese: 「真面目に聞いてよー」
lines.english: “Take me seriously!”

lines.japanese: ははは、うちの小鳩は怒った顔も可愛いなあ。
lines.english: Ha ha ha. My Kobato was adorable even when she was angry.

lines.japanese: 「私はお兄ちゃんともっといっぱい話がしたいのに……」
lines.english: “I want to talk to you lots and lots more, Big Brother...”

lines.japanese: 「ぐっ！」
lines.english: “Ghk!”

lines.japanese: ボソリと嬉しいことを仰るものですから、わたくしはまたしても甘いいかづちに撃たれるのでありました。
lines.english: She murmured something so delightful that once again I was struck by a sweet bolt from heaven.

lines.japanese: つねに愛らしく、とわに守ってさしあげたい小鳩さん。この方が、わたくしの大事な天使。
lines.english: Ever adorable, forever the one I wished to protect—Miss Kobato was my precious angel.

lines.japanese: あっ、いや、べつに俺、シスコンとかロリコンとか全然ないけどね。
lines.english: Oh, but I don't have a sister complex or a Lolita complex or anything.
